sverre.idlePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production transparent animation sprite sheet for Emberfell.
Image 1 is the EXACT desired pixel art STYLE and idle pose reference: richly shaded but crisp 48-pixel seated household sprites with small chibi faces, restrained readable eyes, warm outlines, tidy pixel clusters. Image 2 is IDENTITY/CLOTHING reference only. Rebuild this outdoor character as a STANDING FULL BODY character in the SAME style as image 1. Sverre, adult man with warm medium-brown skin, dark short hair under a plain navy-teal wool cap, navy-teal padded winter coat, brick-red scarf, brown gloves and boots.
Exactly 4 equal columns × 4 equal rows on 1024×1024 genuinely transparent canvas; sixteen sprites. Logical source cell 64×64 enlarged 4 times with hard square pixels. Full body about 28–34 logical pixels wide and 52 logical pixels high. Slightly overhead classic RPG view. Large head and short sturdy body, match the household faces and carefully shaded winter clothing, no anime giant eyes. All frames in a direction have identical size, scale, palette, alignment and foot baseline. Entire character including boots stays inside cell with broad clear gutters.
Rows: SOUTH/front, NORTH/back (absolutely no face), EAST/right profile, WEST/left profile.
Columns are four idle states: 1 neutral with eyes open; 2 quiet inhale, cloth chest/shoulders rise by ONE logical pixel, face and hair completely unchanged; 3 half blink, eyelids lowered halfway; 4 full blink, every visible eye is a short closed dark eyelid line with no pupil or white. Blink frames change ONLY eyelids, never squash face or move hair. North row has no face; blink columns stay neutral. Feet planted in exactly the same place. Arms relaxed at sides; no walking, gestures, props or weapons. No chairs, tables, ground, shadows, scenery, labels, grid lines, colored haze, antialiasing, gradients or soft painting. Genuine clear alpha background. Consistent professional 16-bit RPG pixel art rather than tiny crude outline-only sprites.
